name: Stitch relay model (Stitch.Relay)
statement: Stitch's relay model at the commit Verdant Engine v2.22.4 pins: framed, bounded messages under topics hashed from secrets only holders know, which carry the sealed sync between the instances of one Prism ID. Cited by the agent interface's transport between instances (REQ-AGENT-INTERFACE, REQ-DISTRIBUTED-INSTANCES).
